news.title: GPT-6.1 Terra: measured tool-workflow value
news.summary: AA v5.0.1 Medium: index 38, AutomationBench 58%, $0.17 per task. Sol Medium: 46, 63%, $0.36. Terra is documented for Work, Codex and API. Higher independent Terra effort results remain pending.

news.title: Recurring API credits for eligible Max/Team plans
news.summary: Max5x $100/month; Max20x $200; Team $20/Standard or $100/Premium seat, pooled up to$500. Seven-day eligibility and one linked Console organization required. Credits expire each billing cycle, with no rollover. API billing benefit, not a token-price or subscription-limit change.

news.title: Argon introductory API pricing
news.summary: $2 input / $10 output per million tokens through November 30, then $4 / $20. API offer only; subscription allowances are separate.

news.title: Gemini 4 Carbon restricted rollout
news.summary: AA Low, Medium and High score 54, 58 and 60 at $7.19, $6.59 and $7.76 per benchmark task. Google is phasing access through selected partners. Announced introductory prices have no verified effective window.

review.note: Cloud comparisons use the AA v5.0.1 cost basket. Incomplete rows retain dated history. GDPval-AA Elo, SciCode and no-tools HLE retain the separate v4.3.2 scores and cost basket. Local results are frozen. Restricted-access Carbon is recorded separately.

overall_value_leader.basis: For ordinary branching tool workflows: AutomationBench 58% at $0.17 per task. Sol medium adds 5 points at $0.36, or 4.6 points per cost doubling, below the 5-point threshold. Work, Codex and API availability only. Use Sol low for consequential facts and Sol xhigh for coding. AA v5.0.1 API costs do not measure subscription savings.

rule: An upgrade pays when it adds at least 5 points (or 75 Elo on GDPval) for each doubling of cost per task. Below that, the cheaper setting is the sweet spot.
